rationale: Because (che + flow)/(capx+dlc) is exactly the sum of the two legs being rank-combined, this is a rank-weighting reparameterization of the archive's already-tested stock-plus-flow coverage signal rather than a new economic claim.

This merely swaps MA(capx,3) for TS_MAX(capx,3) in the existing generation-5 leader (alpha 7.1%, t=5.65), a highly correlated parameter tweak whose two "independent" denominators differ only in a 3-year smoothing statistic.

The level/trajectory framing is coherent, but this is a rank blend of two already-evaluated archive signals — one of which carries a wrong-signed FMB slope (-0.83) — so it is portfolio stacking that will mostly reproduce the leader while diluting its cross-sectional evidence.

target_name: Volatility of resources relative to commitments
rationale: The second-moment idea is new to the family, but dividing by (capx+dlc) makes the signal mechanically large for low-commitment firms, so the negative expected sign directly contradicts the direction established by the coverage leaders and the result risks being an inverted commitment-intensity proxy plus the known cash-flow-volatility anomaly.

A genuinely different construction within the productive family — a monotone six-state count of self-funding years that tests durability versus level, is outlier-robust without winsorization, and avoids the degenerate-mask problem of the earlier failed INDICATOR signal.

Internally inconsistent: since ZSCORE is affine, multiplying by (capx+dlc)/at algebraically cancels the coverage denominator, so the expression collapses to roughly (che+cash flow)/at minus a multiple of commitment intensity — a cash-profitability-minus-investment composite, not the claimed magnitude-scaled quality interaction.
